en: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers; or a building used for a special purpose; or to place someone somewhere.
ex: We arrived at the station ten minutes early.
我們提早十分鐘抵達車站。

en: To remain in a place and not leave; or to live somewhere for a short time; or a period of time in a place.
ex: We stayed at a hotel near the beach.
我們住在海灘附近的旅館。

en: Up to now or then; or without moving; or even; or calm and quiet.
ex: It is still raining outside.
外面還在下雨。

en: To end a movement or action; or a place where a bus or train stops.
ex: Please stop talking and listen to the teacher.
請別再說話，聽老師講。

en: A place where goods are sold; or to keep something for future use.
ex: She bought some milk from the store.
她從商店買了一些牛奶。

en: A description of events, real or imaginary, told to entertain; or a floor of a building.
ex: Her grandmother told her a bedtime story.
她的祖母給她講了一個睡前故事。

en: Going in one direction without bending or turning; or directly; or honest.
ex: Go straight and turn left at the second corner.
直走，在第二個轉角左轉。

en: Unusual and surprising; or not known or seen before.
ex: I heard a strange noise in the middle of the night.
我在半夜聽到一個奇怪的聲音。

en: A public road in a town or city with houses and shops along it.
ex: The children are playing on the street.
孩子們在街上玩耍。

en: A thin piece of rope used for tying things; or a series of things joined together; or to hang things on a cord.
ex: She tied the box with a piece of string.
她用一條細繩把盒子綁起來。

en: Having great physical power; or very firm and hard to break; or having a lot of flavor or force.
ex: He is strong enough to lift a heavy box.
他夠強壯，可以舉起一個重箱子。

en: A person who is studying at a school, college or university.
ex: The student raised his hand to ask a question.
那名學生舉手提問。

en: To learn about a subject by reading, going to classes or doing research; or a room for reading and writing.
ex: She studies English for one hour every evening.
她每天晚上念一小時英語。

en: Showing a lack of thought or good sense.
ex: It was stupid of me to forget my keys.
我忘了帶鑰匙真是愚蠢。

en: A particular area of study, such as math; or the thing being talked or written about; or a person under a ruler.
ex: My favorite subject at school is English.
我在學校最喜歡的科目是英語。

en: Achieving what you wanted to achieve; or having become rich or famous.
ex: She became a successful doctor after years of hard work.
經過多年努力，她成為一位成功的醫生。

en: A sweet substance, usually white, added to food and drinks; or to add sugar to something.
ex: Do you take sugar in your tea?
你的茶要加糖嗎？

en: The star that gives light and heat to the Earth; or the light and heat that comes from it.
ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
太陽從東方升起，從西方落下。

en: Full of sunlight; or cheerful and happy.
ex: It was a sunny day, so we went to the beach.
那天是晴天，所以我們去了海灘。

en: A large store that sells food and other things for the home.
ex: I bought some milk and bread at the supermarket.
我在超市買了一些牛奶和麵包。

en: Having no doubt that you are right; or certainly; or used to agree with someone.
ex: Are you sure you locked the door?
你確定你有鎖門嗎？

en: A feeling caused by something unexpected; or an unexpected event; or to make someone feel this.
ex: We planned a surprise party for her birthday.
我們為她的生日策劃了一個驚喜派對。

en: Feeling shocked because something unexpected has happened.
ex: I was surprised to see him at the party.
在派對上見到他，我感到很驚訝。

en: Having a taste like sugar; or pleasant; or a piece of candy.
ex: The cake is too sweet for me.
這蛋糕對我來說太甜了。

en: A short-sleeved shirt shaped like the letter T, with no collar or buttons.
ex: He wore a white T-shirt and blue jeans.
他穿著白T恤和藍色牛仔褲。

en: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs; or a set of facts and numbers in rows.
ex: The family sat around the table for dinner.
全家人圍坐在桌邊吃晚餐。

en: The part that sticks out behind an animal's body; or the back or end of something; or to follow someone secretly.
ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
那隻狗開心地搖著尾巴。

en: To carry something with you; or to get something; or to need an amount of time; or to travel by something.
ex: Please take an umbrella with you today.
今天請你帶一把傘。

en: To say things to someone in conversation; or a conversation; or a speech given to an audience.
ex: I talked to my friend on the phone for an hour.
我和朋友講了一個小時的電話。

en: Having a greater than average height; or having a particular height.
ex: She is tall and wants to be a basketball player.
她個子高，想成為籃球員。

en: A narrow band of material used for sticking things together or recording sound; or to record something.
ex: He used tape to stick the poster on the wall.
他用膠帶把海報貼在牆上。

en: The flavor of food or drink; or to eat or drink a small amount to try it; or the ability to like certain things.
ex: This soup tastes very good.
這道湯嚐起來很好喝。

en: A car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere.
ex: We took a taxi to the airport.
我們搭計程車去機場。

en: A hot drink made by pouring hot water on dried leaves; or the dried leaves used to make it.
ex: Would you like a cup of tea?
你想喝杯茶嗎？

en: To give lessons in a subject; or to show someone how to do something.
ex: She teaches English at a junior high school.
她在一所國中教英語。

en: A person whose job is to teach in a school.
ex: Our teacher gives us homework every day.
我們的老師每天都給我們作業。

en: A group of people who play a game or work together; or to join together to do something.
ex: Our team won the basketball game yesterday.
我們的隊伍昨天贏了籃球賽。

en: A person between thirteen and nineteen years old.
ex: Many teenagers like to listen to pop music.
許多青少年喜歡聽流行音樂。

en: A machine you use to speak to someone far away; or to call someone on it.
ex: I will phone you when I get home.
我到家時會打電話給你。

en: A machine with a screen on which you can watch programs and films; or the programs broadcast on it.
ex: I watch TV for an hour after dinner.
我晚餐後看一個小時的電視。
